one_sentence_story: In 2018 at Wake Forest and USC, scientists recorded how each patient's memory hub translated incoming signals from zone CA3 to zone CA1, and playing that personalized electrical pattern back boosted short-term recall by 37 percent.
so_what_for_you: Forming a lasting memory depends on a split-second electrical handoff inside your hippocampus — and instead of blasting the brain with raw current, neural prosthetics can now whisper the brain's own timing code to help memories stick.
